question: What share of the combined emissions of all 10 countries shown does China represent? (A) ~85% (B) ~45% (C) ~30%. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the climate bar chart. The y-axis starts just below the smallest bar instead of at 0, exaggerating differences. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): truncated axis. True answer: B (~45%). Bait: C (~30%).
